translation.adviceOneText: 'There is no marriage except with a wali and two witnesses of good character.' | (Sunan Abu Dawood)
translation.adviceTwoText: The involvement of a wali in the marriage process ensures adherence to Islamic norms and provides a layer of protection and counsel for the woman. | Sheikh Al-Albani
translation.adviceThreeText: The guidance of a wali in matrimonial matters is not just tradition but a safeguard designed by Allah to protect her dignity and rights.
translation.adviceFourText: Nor come nigh to adultery: for it is a shameful (deed) and an evil, opening the road (to other evils). | (Surah Al-Isra, 17:32)
translation.adviceFiveText: When two people (illegally) are together alone then the third is shaitaan (Satan). | (Sahih Bukhari)
translation.adviceSixText: Speak good or remain silent. Let your words be filled with goodness and respect, for each syllable is witnessed by Allah.
translation.adviceSevenText: Guard your tongue from casual and needless conversations that lead away from righteousness. | Sheikh Ibn Baz
translation.adviceEightText: And say to My servants that they should (only) say those things that are best: for Satan doth sow dissensions among them: Surely, Satan is to man an open enemy. | (Surah Al-Isra, 17:53)
translation.adviceNineText: A good word is charity. | (Sahih Bukhari)
translation.adviceTenText: And speak to people good [words]. | (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:83)
translation.adviceElevenText: Avoid much joking, as it deadens the heart and takes away the light of the face. | Sheikh Ibn Uthaymeen
translation.adviceTwelveText: Successful indeed are the believers, Those who humble themselves in their prayers, Who avoid vain talk... | (Surah Al-Mu'minun, 23:1-3)
translation.adviceThirteenText: The believer does not slander, curse, or speak in an obscene or foul manner. | (Sunan At-Tirmidhi)
translation.icebreakerFourText: Assalamu alaikum! Hope you're having a blessed day.
